title: SpidR-Adapt: A Universal Speech Representation Model for Few-Shot Adaptation
venueFull: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL)
summary: SpidR-Adapt treats low-resource speech representation learning as meta-learning. It combines multi-task adaptive pre-training, first-order bi-level optimization and interleaved supervision to adapt speech units to new languages with under one hour of unlabeled audio, about 100x more data-efficient than standard multi-task training.
